RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT (EXCERPT FOR Q&A TESTING)

1. Late Fee. If Rent is not received within five (5) days of the due date,
Tenant shall pay a late fee of $75. This late fee is in addition to the
monthly Rent and does not waive Landlord's other remedies.

2. Notice to Vacate. Either party may terminate this month-to-month tenancy
by giving the other party fourteen (14) days' written notice.

3. Pets. No pets of any kind are permitted on the premises at any time,
without exception.

4. Guests. Guests may not stay more than ten (10) consecutive days without
prior written consent from Landlord.
